source_base.meaning: Explicitly authorized private source base only; public200 qualification is not inherited.

parity_policy.result: Exact uint8 mask bytes, shape, dtype, strides, ownership/aliasing and writability; no allclose.
parity_policy.observables: Exact profile-specific warnings, exception type/message/order, input mutations, height/footprint events and stage order.
parity_policy.unsafe: Fourteen inherited source guards remain blocked. SourceUnsafeBoundary is instrumentation, not an upstream exception or native parity pass.
parity_policy.reference: Only genuine calls of authenticated installed original 0.26; untouched observer certificates precede unchecked Cython.
parity_policy.arithmetic: Freeze stage dtypes, source operation order and comparisons before candidate output. No tolerance widening, reassociation, FMA substitution, oracle fitting or case removal.
parity_policy.original_resolution: 2 * np.finfo(image.dtype).resolution * abs(image), not eps. Every new resolution-labelled case must complete original Cython.
parity_policy.wide_integer: The original reconstruction converts every integer dtype to float64. Preserve rounded conversion and subsequent NumPy comparison; do not replace it by idealized wide-integer residue arithmetic.

initial_native_scope.height: Ordinary positive builtin integer; source early exits and errors retain their actual order.
initial_native_scope.range: Typed unsigned-modular subtraction followed by signed interpretation for signed ptp; preserve wrapped negative range and h > range before h == 0.
initial_native_scope.saturation: Unsigned bit arithmetic and distance-to-endpoint tests, without C++ signed overflow or an unnecessary 128-bit floating substitute.
initial_native_scope.footprint: The owned reconstruction shell evaluates footprint conversion after seed materialization, and its shape-assignment warning before final residue.
initial_native_scope.final_stage: Read current image after callbacks; revalidate pinned owner chains, current metadata and allocation spans before every native read.
initial_native_scope.reconstruction: Reuse exact cee owner/offset-repaired kernel/binder/shell; never use the historical 095 binder.
initial_native_scope.thread_policy: One inherited SDK worker state, default one; optional shared worker setting. Independent preparation/output scans may use SIMD and workers; dependent flood remains serial.
initial_native_scope.provider_boundary: Any NumPy array computation or original algorithm forwarding is explicitly identified. No upstream H/reconstruction/rank-order forwarding is a native implementation.

mandatory_followups: Finite float16/float32/float64 preparation and residue with exact source resolution/cutoff decisions across all profiles.
Height scalar promotion, fractional-integer warning/cast, typed integers/floats, array-valued height and custom protocols with source order.
Bool/empty/0D/complex/negative/zero/nonfinite/error precedence; unsafe original domains remain separately accounted for.
Negative-zero representative provider and reconstruction floating-environment frontier remain explicit until separately resolved.
Complete ordinary/protocol/foreign-owner behavior and public integration/qualification; an initial integer increment is not full API completion.

capture_plan.windows: Preserve old468 exact; capture additive348 only.
capture_plan.all_runs: Existing authenticated runtimes only; isolated raw JSON and append-only journal; one thread; no timing or native calls.

future_measurement.original: Authenticated original 0.26 isolated one-thread complete calls.
future_measurement.inputs: Reuse fixed factory; both APIs, integer widths and mandatory float/promotion domains, real limits, saturation, resolution, cutoffs, layouts and footprint-dependent flooding.
future_measurement.reporting: Retain full case denominator and explicit unsupported/provider/early-return groups. No speed claim before fresh isolated measurement.
